records.label: A600-01 · Dryer readiness — twelve REP-016 holds
records.detail: D-A600-03 records the REP-016 V1.4 readiness statement as controlling: DR-601 is NOT READY, twelve high-priority HOLDs open (HOLD-1…8 on the dryer: atomizer, rheology / solids, H&M balance, moisture and product temperature, heating medium and HX-601, dust, LEL, explosion protection; HOLD-9 F-601 sizing; HOLD-10 SC-601 sizing). D-A600-01 withdrew every MEB-008 V6 rate — evaporation, drying air, feed 50 kg/h graphite, product 27.8 kg/h (about half the DBM V2.0 nominal of 57 kg/h), the cyclone / bottom / baghouse recovery split, the 3,840 kW HX-601 duty and the BL-601 / FN-601 / P-601 powers. The modelled tower, filter house and scrubber are layout envelopes.
records.action: Close HOLD-1…8, then re-issue MEB-008 (V7) on DBM V2.0 (63.5 kg/h graphite; ≈ 57–74 kg/h dried TLGO) with the recovery train as drawn; size F-601 and SC-601 (HOLD-9 / 10) on that balance before any vendor enquiry.

records.label: A600-02 · Drying envelope and feed solids
records.status: Targets approved — subject to HOLD-4 / HOLD-1
records.detail: Approved as current design targets (D-A600-02, single source MEB-008): 140 °C air inlet, 85 °C outlet, 2 wt% residual moisture — each subject to the HOLD-4 product-temperature and final-moisture limits. Feed solids ≈ 1 wt% is approved with the REP-025 reasoning that it is a rheological / atomisation ceiling (GO nematic gel by ~1 wt%), so upstream mechanical dewatering (REP-017 / REP-036, about 5 wt% from A-400) is the lever; MEB-008 carries the same 0.01 number. HX-601 duty ≈ 3.8 MW at 1 wt% is the dominant A-600 utility and its heating medium is HOLD-5.
records.action: Test atomisation of TLGO slurry above 1 wt% (HOLD-1 / HOLD-2) and decide the A-400 → A-600 concentration basis jointly with D-A400-01 and D-A500-02; fix the HX-601 heating medium with the A-5000 review (≥ 200 °C loop).

records.label: A600-03 · Combustible dust, LEL and explosion protection
records.detail: D-A600-03 adopts the REP-016 HOLD-6…8 requirements as safeguard intent for DR-601, F-601 and T-602 — combustible dust hazard assessment, solvent vapour / LEL monitoring, explosion protection — with MAT-002 M-040 conductive, grounded PTFE filter media. The model shows the recovery train (F-601 → FN-601 → SC-601) and the contained receiver T-602 at the dryer cone; no venting, suppression or isolation devices are represented.
records.action: Complete the dust hazard assessment (Kst, MIE, MIT on dried TLGO), select explosion protection and isolation for DR-601 / F-601 / T-602, define LEL monitoring, and carry the result into the P&ID and the datasheets.

records.label: A600-04 · Materials of construction
records.status: Ruled — F-601 and T-602 not yet covered
records.detail: D-A600-MOC applies MAT-002: 316L / 321 electropolished product-contact surfaces (Ra ≤ 0.8 µm) for DR-601, HX-601 and BL-601; PVDF / PTFE-lined lines with PVDF-lined or 316L pump and tungsten-carbide or ceramic nozzle for T-601 / P-601; vinyl-ester FRP scrubber with PP / PVDF packing for SC-601 and FN-601. MDL-001 (HDPE / XLPE tank, 304L casings, OEM aluminium blower) superseded. F-601 and T-602 have an MDL-001 material only and remain candidate until MAT-002 covers them.
records.action: Extend MAT-002 to F-601 (housing and media) and T-602; issue the A-600 datasheets on the MAT-002 base case once HOLD-1…8 close.

records.label: A600-05 · Register and model reconciliation
records.detail: All nine LST-001 tags (T-601, P-601, DR-601, BL-601, HX-601, F-601, FN-601, SC-601, T-602) are bound to model geometry. The model also owns the scrubber recirculation pump P-SC601, the battery limit BL-A600, the stair tower PL-601, two fire points and three emergency stations without register identities. Two items named in design notes are absent from PFD-0600, LST-001 and the model: cyclone CY-601 (the PFD routes the dryer discharge directly to the F-601 bag-filter house) and blower B-601 (the register calls it BL-601). Fifteen interface records (gas, exhaust, water, blowdown, CIP supply / return, dryer and filter wash and vents, feed and scrubber pump drains) have no destinations.
records.action: Register P-SC601 and BL-A600 on LST-001; rule CY-601 in or out with the MEB-008 V7 recovery split; align the B-601 / BL-601 name; assign destinations to the fifteen interfaces on PFD-0600 (A-3000 for exhaust, A-1000 for wash and blowdown).

records.label: A600-06 · Access, maintenance and fire points
records.detail: The model provides a dedicated dryer / filter access stair tower PL-601 (1,166 parts) and places fire points at the dryer stair approach (FE-601) and the dryer feed approach (FE-602), with three emergency stations ES-601 … ES-603. Platform loads, bag-change and atomizer-removal routes, and the T-602 receiver change-out are not qualified by this review; wash interfaces (dryer wash, filter wash, wash collection) exist as records only.
records.action: Qualify the PL-601 tower against the atomizer, bag and cone maintenance tasks (lifted masses, laydown, hoist), confirm fire-point and station positions in the plant-wide access and fire-safety reviews, and define the wash-down and wash-collection routes.
